fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Confirmed General Mills Bakeries & Foodservice frozen-dough plant, 1157 Doughboy Drive, ~110,000 sq ft on ~9.7 acres, built 1995, 8 dock doors, 5 spiral freezers, ammonia refrigeration. Listed for sale on Showcase.com/LoopNet (frozen dough operation, now a separate-tenant property).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is an open driveway at the north end through a gap in the perimeter chain-link fence - no barrier arm, slide gate or checkpoint visible in Street View (2025-04). truckGate = false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance in any Street View heading.
fieldNotes.perimeterFence: Property is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence, but the truck entrance itself is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Showcase/LoopNet listing states 8 dock doors; recessed loading area visible on the building's west face in Street View - dockDoors band 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open paved lot SW of the building with capacity for trailer parking, but few/no trailers seen in current imagery - drop area band 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: North entrance driveway runs a long way from Doughboy Drive into the property before reaching the building/dock - deep approach, can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park near I-44/Hwy-2 outside Vinita, surrounded by open farmland - Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; nearest rail line is well west of the industrial park.
